facts: We Keep You Spry (WKYS) installs AI tools across a business, trains the team to run them and hands every system over to the owner.

The Assessment costs $1,500: a review of the business's workflows, tools, accounts and data that ends in a written roadmap and a fixed quote; its fee is credited to the install if the owner goes ahead.
The 30-day install costs $10,000: the agreed systems are set up in accounts the business owns, tested, documented and handed over with training within 30 days.

The 90-day engagement costs from $25,000: the 30-day install followed by two more months of scoped builds, tests, training and a full handover; the exact price is fixed in writing after the Assessment.
Everything is built in accounts in the client's name; the client keeps its accounts, data and commissioned deliverables under the agreement.
Software the client chooses is billed to the client's own accounts at the vendor's price.
There is no retainer after handover; further work is a separately scoped project with its own quote.
The way to start is the inquiry form on wekeepyouspry.com, choosing the Assessment.
lacks: We Keep You Spry does not run a client's business, sales pipeline or marketing, and does not promise sales, growth or revenue.
We Keep You Spry does not sell its own software product or app.
We Keep You Spry does not give legal advice; where rules apply, steps are written out for the client's own counsel to review.
We Keep You Spry does not publish client names, case studies or results.
We Keep You Spry does not offer calls as a first step; the first step is the Assessment through the form.
